verdict.rationale: DPMA's docs publish some exact filing deadlines: a one-year window from filing to claim internal priority, and twelve months to submit a German translation for English or French applications. Nothing in the pack covers penalties, surcharges, late fees or interest for missing those deadlines, so only half the story is evidenced, and thinly. Missing for 10: a published penalty/surcharge/interest schedule with exact figures, a comprehensive deadline list (e.g. renewal/annual fee due dates, trade mark deadlines), independent corroboration.
